summary: AnyRouter is an OpenAI-compatible model router. Donate one eligible provider key in Dashboard > BYOK and, while the key stays valid, the account gets the Go plan and every request the shared Pool serves costs $0. Donation is opt-in per key, your own requests take priority over the pool, and you can withdraw the key at any time. The Free plan gets a 5-request lifetime trial on free and decision models; without a donated key, free models require Go ($2/month). There is no payout, percentage back or extra donor credit.
claim_steps: Sign up at https://anyrouter.dev (free, no card required).
Open Dashboard > BYOK at https://anyrouter.dev/dashboard/byok and add a provider key that AnyRouter can route.
Flip 'Donate to pool' on that key and confirm the 'Key verified' step.
Check the dashboard: Go is active and models the Pool can serve are requested at $0. Browse them at https://anyrouter.dev/models?free=true.
